# Plugins follow owner windowId across late mount and window moves

Owned by `@neo-gemini-maryam` and implemented in the filing session to close two verified Engine 14 multi-window plugin defects ahead of the `2026-11-23` cut (`defect-note` `MESSAGE:966fc42d` and `MESSAGE:2ef500bc`), so curated contributor labels (`good first issue` / `help wanted`) are omitted (`ticket-create` §4).

## Context

In Engine 14's multi-window workflows (`DockWorkspace` tear-out/pop-out, `Workstation`, `WebDesktop`, `LivePreview` pop-out, and headless-first component creation like #21579), components routinely acquire `windowId` after construction (`null → windowId`) or move across windows (`windowA → windowB` or `windowA → null → windowB`).

While `Neo.component.Abstract#afterSetWindowId` forwards `windowId` to `controller` and `stateProvider`, and #20722 gave `Neo.selection.Model` reactive `observeConfig(component, 'windowId', ...)` tracking, `Neo.plugin.Base` sets `this.windowId = owner.windowId` **only once** inside `onOwnerConstructed()` (`src/plugin/Base.mjs:93-99`) when `owner.windowId` is already truthy at construction time.

## The Problem

 Sweeping all 13 `Neo.plugin.Base` subclasses in `src/` surfaces five concrete failures caused by `plugin.windowId` never following `owner.windowId` after construction:

1. **Late-mounted plugin stylesheets never load (`Neo.plugin.Base#afterSetWindowId`):** Any component constructed with `windowId: null` (headless containers, lazy cards, torn-out panes) leaves `plugin.windowId === null` permanently unless the subclass writes a manual mount workaround (`src/plugin/Popover.mjs:166-168`).
2. **`Neo.plugin.Resizable` keeps its `dragZone` and deltas pointed at the old/null window (`src/plugin/Resizable.mjs:259-267`):** `Resizable` already defines `afterSetWindowId` to load its theme files and update `me.dragZone.windowId = value`, and dispatches resize cursor/node deltas to `this.windowId` (`:210, :492, :612`), yet nothing updates `resizablePlugin.windowId` when the owner gets or changes `windowId`.
3. **`Neo.plugin.PrefixField` leaks its Main-Thread `InputMask` controller on the old window (`src/plugin/PrefixField.mjs:225-232, :271-286`):** Moving a masked `TextField` from `windowA` to `windowB` registers on `windowB` at remount without calling `addon.unregister({id, windowId: windowA})`, leaving `InputMask` DOM listeners and map entries alive in `windowA`.
4. **`Neo.list.plugin.Animate` strands owner-scoped CSS rules in `null` or the departing window (`src/list/plugin/Animate.mjs:180, :222, :506, :1034-1043`):** `Animate#construct` calls `updateTransitionDetails()` before `onOwnerConstructed` runs, so even when `owner.windowId` is `2` at construction time, `CssUtil.insertRules(me.windowId, ...)` fires with `me.windowId === null`; and on window transfer or late `windowId` assignment, `#<ownerId>` / `#<ownerId> .neo-list-item` rules are never deleted from `oldValue` or inserted into the new window.
5. **`Neo.table.plugin.CellEditing` and `Neo.plugin.Popover` target the wrong window (`src/table/plugin/CellEditing.mjs:112, :140`; `src/plugin/Popover.mjs:176, :185`):** `table.plugin.CellEditing` caches column `TextField` editors in `this.editors` with stale `windowId`, and `Popover` calls `Neo.main.addon.Popover.show/hide({id})` without `windowId`, routing multi-window hover popovers to the primary window.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `src/plugin/Popover.mjs:163-164` (*"An owner can get its window after it was constructed. Mounted, it has one: the plugin takes it, which loads the stylesheet that places the popover (plugin.Base#afterSetWindowId)"*), `src/plugin/Resizable.mjs:254-267` (`afterSetWindowId` updating `dragZone.windowId` and calling `insertThemeFiles`), and #20722 (`src/selection/Model.mjs:314`, establishing `observeConfig(component, 'windowId', ...)` as the canonical non-component window-tracking seam).
- `src/plugin/Base.mjs:82` explicitly notes that a plugin may be instantiated directly via `Neo.create(Plugin, {owner})` without being listed in `owner.plugins`. Subscribing inside `Neo.plugin.Base#construct` via `this.observeConfig(owner, 'windowId', value => {this.windowId = value})` (guarded by `owner instanceof Base` so plain-object unit stubs emit no `observeConfig` warning) handles both `owner.plugins` and standalone `{owner}` plugins, initializes `me.windowId = owner.windowId` synchronously during `Plugin#construct` before subclass constructor bodies run, and unsubscribes automatically on `plugin.destroy()` via `Neo.core.Base#destroy` (`src/core/Base.mjs:821`).

## The Fix

1. **`src/plugin/Base.mjs`:** In `construct(config)`, seed `me.windowId = owner.windowId` when `owner?.windowId && me.windowId === null` (so subclass `construct` bodies like `Animate` already see `me.windowId`), and when `owner instanceof Base`, subscribe `me.observeConfig(owner, 'windowId', value => {me.windowId = value})`. Retain `onOwnerConstructed()` as an idempotent hook for backward compatibility.
2. **`src/plugin/Popover.mjs`:** Delete the now-redundant `onOwnerMounted()` override (`7` lines removed — Accretion Defense) and pass `windowId: this.windowId` to `Neo.main.addon.Popover.hide` and `Neo.main.addon.Popover.show`.
3. **`src/plugin/PrefixField.mjs`:** Add `afterSetWindowId(value, oldValue)` calling `super.afterSetWindowId(value, oldValue)`, unregistering `owner.getInputElId()` from `oldValue`'s `PrefixField` addon when `oldValue && oldValue !== value`, and re-registering when `value && oldValue !== undefined && owner?.mounted`; delete the manual `if (owner.windowId) { me.windowId = owner.windowId }` block in `onOwnerMounted()`.
4. **`src/plugin/Resizable.mjs`:** Delegate theme injection in `afterSetWindowId` to `super.afterSetWindowId(value, oldValue)` while updating `me.dragZone.windowId = value`.
5. **`src/table/plugin/CellEditing.mjs`:** Add `afterSetWindowId(value, oldValue)` calling `super.afterSetWindowId(value, oldValue)` and updating `editor.windowId = value` across cached `this.editors`.
6. **`src/list/plugin/Animate.mjs`:** Add `afterSetWindowId(value, oldValue)` calling `super.afterSetWindowId(value, oldValue)` and, when `oldValue !== undefined && me.isConstructed`, deleting owner rules from truthy `oldValue` and calling `me.updateTransitionDetails()` for truthy `value`.
7. **Unit coverage:** Add `test/playwright/unit/plugin/WindowIdPropagation.spec.mjs` (and extend `test/playwright/unit/plugin/PrefixField.spec.mjs`) covering headless `null → windowId` late mount, `windowA → windowB` transfer across `Plugin`, `Popover`, `Resizable`, `PrefixField`, `table.plugin.CellEditing`, and `list.plugin.Animate`, standalone `Neo.create(Plugin, {owner})` tracking, and `plugin.destroy()` unsubscription.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Constructing a component with `windowId: null` and later setting `component.windowId = 2` updates `plugin.windowId` to `2` and invokes `insertThemeFiles(2, plugin.__proto__)` — with `Popover#onOwnerMounted` deleted and `Popover` addon `show`/`hide` calls carrying `windowId`.
- [ ] AC-2: Moving an owner across windows (`1 → 2` and `1 → null → 2`) updates `Resizable#dragZone.windowId`, cached `table.plugin.CellEditing#editors[*].windowId`, and `list.plugin.Animate` owner CSS rules (`deleteRules` on `1`, `insertRules` on `2`; initial `{windowId: 2}` construction inserts directly on `2`).
- [ ] AC-3: Moving a mounted `TextField` with `PrefixField` from `windowId: 1` to `windowId: 2` unregisters `InputMask` on `windowId: 1` and registers on `windowId: 2`.
- [ ] AC-4: Destroying a plugin while its owner lives stops `windowId` observation (`plugin.windowId` does not mutate and `insertThemeFiles` is not called on subsequent `owner.windowId` changes), and standalone `Neo.create(Plugin, {owner})` follows `owner.windowId` identically to `owner.plugins`.
- [ ] AC-5: Existing and new unit suites (`WindowIdPropagation.spec.mjs`, `PrefixField.spec.mjs`, `Resizable.spec.mjs`, `animatePlugin.spec.mjs`) pass cleanly.

## Out of Scope

- Refactoring `Neo.dashboard.dock.plugin.Maximize` or `Neo.grid.plugin.CellEditing` session suspension (#20800), which already manage specialized multi-step cross-window lifecycles beyond `plugin.windowId`.

## Avoided Traps

- **Forwarding only from `component.Base#afterSetWindowId`:** Fails for plugins created directly via `Neo.create(Plugin, {owner})` outside `owner.plugins` (`src/plugin/Base.mjs:82`) and touches the 2,180-line `src/component/Base.mjs` unnecessarily; `observeConfig` in `Neo.plugin.Base` handles every plugin instance uniformly and auto-disposes in `Neo.core.Base#destroy`.
- **Calling `observeConfig` on non-`Base` unit stubs:** Unit tests such as `Resizable.spec.mjs` invoke methods on plain-object stubs; guarding `owner instanceof Base` avoids spurious warnings while preserving full runtime behavior.
- **Skipping initial `updateTransitionDetails()` in `Animate#construct` when `windowId` is `null`:** `animatePlugin.spec.mjs` verifies rule generation in `windowId: null` unit fixtures; keeping the constructor pass while migrating rules on `oldValue !== undefined` preserves unit fixtures and fixes multi-window runtime routing.
